dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep, concave curvature fitting a high-degree spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded geometry with a small pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline of the anterior margin relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 0.8:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Pronounced convex curvature of the melon boundary with a smooth, high-radius arc.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio projecting from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch is located at the posterior base of the dorsal fin; faint linear rake marks are present on the lateral skin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark pigmented patch surrounding the eye region.
